title: Variance-based Friedgut error
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. The variance-based Friedgut error of $f$ is $\operatorname{Var}(f)/8$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$
caveat: The variance convention used for Boolean functions is not defined in the supplied material.
